{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tammuz-an shipping fleet''' was part of the commerce of [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]].

==History==
The shipping [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] came under threat from [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], notably the gang led by [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]]. Ren-Cha's operation culminated in a theft of a Tammuz-an [[Tanker/Legends|tanker]] and his attempted invasion of the [[Planet/Legends|world]] with the use of a stolen [[Gladiator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Gladiator''-class Star Destroyer]].
